# TEST MATERIAL — original craft challenge

Mira stood at the locked gate. Rain ticked against the brass latch. Waiting was the universal essence of humanity, a profound tapestry teaching all souls that destiny is the ultimate truth of existence.

"Transfer authorization remains contingent upon receipt of the scheduled signal," Mira said. She needed Tovan to give her the key now.

"Transfer authorization remains contingent upon receipt of the scheduled signal," Tovan said. He kept his hand over the pocket.
